identity_sessionExpired: Your session has expired or is no longer valid. Sign in again with your passkey.
identity_subtitle: Verify in your browser without entering a token.
identity_login: Sign in with Passkey / Windows Hello
identity_session: Identity verified. Continue to your authorized libraries.
identity_registerHint: Create a passkey and submit a request. After local approval on the server, sign in separately.
identity_imported: Descriptor matches the current server. The file is never executed and grants no access.
identity_pending: Request submitted. Use a trusted channel to explain your identity and required library access to the administrator.
identity_approved: Use the sign-in button above to verify with your new passkey. Approval alone does not create a session.
identity_rejected: Contact the administrator to confirm the reason. Confirm the registration window and permissions before applying again.
identity_expired: Start a new request. An existing approved passkey can sign in directly without registering again.
identity_polling: Checks at intervals of at least 5 seconds. Closing this page loses its status-query capability.
identity_working: Working… Complete the browser's verification prompt.
identity_cancelled: Verification was cancelled or timed out. You can retry; cancellation grants no access.
identity_unsupported: Use a trusted HTTPS domain and a browser with WebAuthn support. Check the address, certificate trust and browser support. Do not bypass certificate warnings.
identity_limited: Too many requests or the server is busy. Wait at least one minute before retrying.
identity_identity: This passkey cannot sign in. It may be unapproved, disabled, revoked or from another instance. Contact the administrator.
identity_descriptor: The descriptor or instance binding does not match. Download the latest JSON on the correct server page; do not use another instance's file.
identity_closed: Registration is closed. Existing approved passkeys can still sign in. Contact the local administrator for new requests.
identity_loginClosed: Passkey login is not enabled on this server. Contact the local administrator.
identity_unavailable: The request could not be completed. Check the network and server before retrying. Do not resubmit a request whose outcome is uncertain.
identity_help: Passkeys may sync through your platform; they do not prove physical device binding. Windows Hello availability depends on the browser and OS.
identity_replace: Create a new pending request and share its ID with the local administrator through a trusted channel. Sign in after identity checks and key replacement. This page cannot take over an existing user.
identity_recover: Use another approved passkey or ask the server's local administrator to verify your identity, revoke lost credentials and approve a replacement. Recovery cannot bypass verification.
identity_transient: Reloading or closing loses the in-memory query secret; the request remains on the server. Ask the administrator to check its name and ID instead of repeatedly creating requests. Once approved, sign in directly.
identity_trust: Descriptors contain public deployment information only. Downloading, importing or reaching the server does not grant approval. Verify the server identity through a trusted channel.
identity_legacy: Other methods: pairing code / application token
sessionPairingCode: One-time pairing code (optional for an existing session)
sessionPairingHint: Use the local launcher or paste an administrator-issued one-time pairing code. Sessions last 30 minutes, renew while in use, and expire after at most 8 hours. Reloading restores the session.
sessionLogoutFailed: Server logout could not be confirmed. This page disconnected; retry logout or ask the administrator to revoke the session.
transferRelationHint: Required to restore model links. Turn off for field data only; the relationship sheet remains empty.
pivotPreviousResult: Still showing the last successful result
transferLogicHint: Adjacent AND conditions form groups; OR joins those groups. Click Refresh to apply changes.
gateHint: Validate the ModelDB server workspace before editing. Graph sync uses the SDK encrypted channel only (no local files).
gateHintStorage: Connect to the server first. The workspace you open is storage; pick a logical database to define what this canvas edits.
pickLibraryHint: Choose the logical database for this canvas (not the same as the storage session name in older flows).
treeDragHint: Drag to reorder: top/bottom third inserts above/below; middle merges (page→wrap in new group, group→move inside). Click to select; new items go under the selected group, or root if a page/none is selected.
treeAddGroupHint: Add group under selected group, or under root when no group is selected
treeAddPageHint: Add page under selected group, or under root when no group is selected
treeDeleteHint: Delete selected group or page (root cannot be deleted; deleting a group removes its subtree)
gateWorkspaceHint: Must match a database folder on the server. Build default can be set with VITE_MODE_DB_WORKSPACE.
bootstrapRunning: Installing model designer catalog on the workspace…
securityCenterDesignBoundary: Security administration does not grant database access. Disconnect this session before starting a separately authorized design session.
securityCenterDesignLocal: On the server computer, run browser-open in a normal terminal with the same instance configuration, the actual page and API addresses, and the business database.
securityCenterDesignRemote: For a LAN client, ask the administrator for a one-time invitation with access to both the business database and the Designer workspace. Pair on the matching page using Browser session.
securityCenterDesignChoose: After reconnecting, choose the business database and open it. If access is denied, ask the administrator to check both database grants.
securityCenterDesignCommandHint: Command template for the server computer. Replace every placeholder before running it:
i18nAddLocaleFill: Type text after choosing a language
nameInvalidFormat: Unique name must be ASCII letters / digits / _ / - and start with a letter
nameInvalidDuplicate: Unique name collides with another relation
relationSelfLoopPolicyHint: Off by default to prevent imported rows from linking to themselves; enable only for explicit self-loop use cases.
queryPickRootHint: Click a model on the canvas to choose the root
queryCanvasContinueHint: Click a target model or highlighted relation on the canvas to extend the query path
queryCanvasNoNextHint: The current node has no forward relation to continue
queryNoProjection: No output fields are available on this path
queryInterfaceBearerHint: Security mode: use a scoped application Bearer credential. Browser pairing codes and cookies are not service credentials; an interface access key does not replace Bearer authentication.
queryInterfaceLegacyHint: This legacy example is only for the current legacy server. Registry servers reject connectToken headers; use a newly issued scoped Bearer credential.
queryInterfaceParameterExampleHint: The curl example uses Bash and reads credentials from environment variables. Replace sample values with the published conditions; optional parameters may be omitted. After importing into Postman, set credential variables in a private environment or Vault. Do not share or export real credentials.
queryInterfaceReleaseGrantHint: This secret-free configuration pins the complete current release digest. The instance owner reviews it before issuing a credential through the local security CLI. Review the grant again after publishing changes.
pivotDescription: Inspect model rows or the result of a published Query Interface.
pivotInterfacePreviewHint: Open the published result in the full-screen data viewer.
pivotPublishedRulesHint: Parameters and conditions come from this published version. Fixed conditions apply automatically. Edit and republish in Query Designer to change the rules.
pivotNoInterfaceParameters: This interface has no call parameters. Fixed conditions still apply automatically.
pivotNoPublishedConditions: This interface has no enabled filter conditions.
pivotFillParameters: Fill required parameters or the access key, then refresh. Blank optional parameters are omitted; the preview does not rewrite interface conditions.
pivotParameterValidationFailed: Check the highlighted interface parameters, then refresh again.
pivotAccessKeyRequired: Enter the access key for this interface.
pivotParametersPending: Parameters changed. Refresh to apply them to the results.
pivotParameterError_date: Enter a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
pivotParameterError_datetime: Enter a valid date and time, preferably with a timezone, such as 2026-10-17T12:00:00Z.
pivotQuantifier_any: At least one related record matches
pivotEmpty: Run a source to inspect its result.
pivotNoScalarFields: No display fields were selected for this node.
pivotSelectPublishedInterface: Select a published query interface first.
pivotParametersObject: Parameters must be a JSON object.
queryPaginationBasicHint: After the query chain is set, choose the page size. Pagination is off by default.
queryFilterMvpHint: Filters will attach to the selected query node in the next step.
queryPreviewMvpHint: Preview will be connected after the QueryPlan compiler is ready.
toolPageMode: Page mode: click models or relations to toggle the current page
dataClearModelHint: Tombstone all rows for the selected engine model; schema and relations stay registered.
dataClearAllHint: Tombstone every row in the connected logical library; models and relations stay registered.
dataConfirmClearModel: Clear all row data for model "{name}"? Schema is kept.
dataConfirmClearAll: Clear all row data in library "{name}"? Schema is kept.
dataClearAllDone: Cleared all row data in library "{name}".
backupWorkspaceMetadataImported: Designer metadata backup imported. It is not a business graph; use administrative tools to manage and restore it.
backupWorkspaceRegistryWarning: Graph display names could not be loaded. Groups use unique graph codes.
backupWorkspaceRestoreHint: "{name}" will replace this graph's current database files. A safety backup will be attempted first. Current data will be overwritten.
backupWorkspaceServerUpgrade: The server does not support backup names yet. Update and restart it before creating named backups.
backupImportConfirm: Import {file} and restore the current library?
backupImportHint: The file is uploaded to the server backup directory and validated before replacing the current library. A safety backup is attempted first.
backupFileCount: {count} backups are available for this library. Double-click an item to confirm it.
backupEmpty: No backup files are available for this library.
backupRestorePrompt: Enter a backup file name to restore:
backupRestoreConfirm: Restore from {file}? Current library files will be replaced after a safety backup.
backupClearConfirm: Clear all data in {db}? Schema stays registered and a safety backup will be created first.
backupForceResetConfirm: Force-reset {db}? Use this only for corruption recovery; a safety backup is attempted first.
libraryDetailsHint: Unique code identifies the library on the server; display name and description support i18n and may repeat across libraries.
operationIdentityHint: The SDK caller supplies the target record ID.
operationFieldsEmpty: This model has no writable fields.
bindingSurfaceExecuteUnpublished: Publish a binding surface before running it.
bindingSurfaceUiNeedsRefresh: The change was committed, but the view needs to be refreshed.
bindingSurfaceUiRefreshFailed: The change was committed, but refresh failed.
bindingSurfaceUiTableIncompatible: The table view requires tabular query results.
bindingSurfaceUiInvalidJson: Enter valid JSON for the related record.
bindingSurfaceUiRelationEmpty: No relationship operations are published for this Surface.
releaseRollbackConfirm: The historical contract will be migrated and checked for compatibility, then published as a new release. The current release remains in the ledger.
queryInterfaceNotifyPublishFailed: Query interface could not be published
queryInterfaceNotifyRollbackFailed: Query interface could not be rolled back
interfaceIssue_publication_callable_name: A callable name is required before publishing the query interface.
The callable name must be a valid identifier.
The query callable name is already used by another published interface.
interfaceIssue_publication_release_uncha: The current draft is identical to the published query interface release.
interfaceIssue_operation_publication_cal: A callable name is required before publishing the operation interface.
The operation callable name must be a valid identifier.
The operation callable name is already used by another published interface.
interfaceIssue_operation_publication_rel: The current draft is identical to the published operation interface release.
interfaceIssue_operation_publication_com: The operation interface could not be compiled into a publishable execution template.
interfaceIssue_operation_publication_tem: The execution template does not match the current operation interface.
interfaceIssue_binding_surface_publicati: The Binding Surface signature does not match the current draft.
The current draft is identical to the published Binding Surface release.
The Binding Surface could not be compiled into a publishable contract.
interfaceIssueOperationRelation: The relationship operation is incomplete. Check the relation, endpoint models, and role parameters.
interfaceIssueOperationBatch: The batch operation is invalid. Check its transaction policy, failure mode, and limits.
interfaceIssueOperationUpsert: The upsert configuration is invalid. Check match fields and writable fields.
interfaceIssueOperationParameter: A required operation parameter is missing or its mapping is invalid.
interfaceIssueOperationField: The operation field configuration is invalid. Check ownership, duplicates, and mappings.
interfaceIssueOperationIdentity: The record identity configuration is not valid for this operation type.
interfaceIssueOperationConfiguration: The operation interface failed validation. Check the target model and operation type.
interfaceIssueBindingQuery: The query release referenced by the Binding Surface is missing or inactive.
interfaceIssueBindingOperation: A referenced operation release is missing, inactive, or targets an incompatible model.
interfaceIssueBindingMutation: A write route is incomplete or duplicates another route.
interfaceIssueBindingParameter: The Binding Surface parameter configuration contains an invalid source or duplicate.
interfaceIssueBindingTrigger: A write trigger target is missing or used more than once.
interfaceIssueBindingRow: A referenced row field or record node does not exist.
interfaceIssueBindingAccess: The Binding Surface access policy or rate limit is invalid.
interfaceIssueBindingConfiguration: The Binding Surface failed validation. Check its write mode and release references.
interfaceIssueQueryParameter: A query parameter is missing or its value does not match the declared type.
interfaceIssueQueryFilter: A query or aggregate filter could not be compiled. Check its fields, operators, and scope.
interfaceIssueQueryResult: The query output, sorting, or pagination configuration is invalid.
interfaceIssueQueryGraph: The query graph references a missing or ambiguous model relationship.
interfaceIssueQueryConfiguration: The query interface failed publication validation.
interfaceIssueValidationGeneric: The interface failed validation. Check required fields and contract settings.
modelMapInheritanceWarning: The inheritance chain is incomplete or cyclic. Only resolved fields are shown.
modelMapExportHint: Export a model overview first, followed by field sheets named with model unique names, regardless of search or collapsed sections
modelMapExportLimit: Model information exceeds Excel's cell length or worksheet row limit.
transferStageOne: Model export, blank templates and read-only import validation are available. Import writes and interface data follow in later stages.
transferExportHint: Export model fields with original IDs, all language values and relationship references. Filters apply to this model; related models contribute reference IDs only.
transferPreviewHint: Preview and export share these filters. Export includes all matching records (up to 10,000), beyond the current preview rows.
transferFiltersPending: Filters changed. Refresh to see the new results; exporting refreshes the preview first.
transferPreviewFailed: The preview query failed. Check the filters before retrying the export.
transferAllRows: No filters: query and export all records in this model.
transferInterfaceScope: Exports the result returned after refresh. Paginated interfaces export the current page only. No fields outside the interface are fetched.
transferInterfaceReportHint: Aggregated results and results without original IDs are read-only reports and cannot be imported.
transferInterfaceImportHint: Model sheets preserve original IDs, relationships and query paths. Import validates only and does not write to the database.
transferInterfaceDerivedHint: Aggregated results cannot produce an import template.
transferInterfaceReportReady: Exported a read-only report: {rows} model records, {relations} relationships. This file cannot be imported.
transferIssue_interfaceSource: The file's source interface or release differs from the selected interface. Export a new template.
transferIssue_interfacePath: The query path, model or record reference is inconsistent.
transferIssue_interfaceConflict: The same ID has conflicting field values across query paths.
transferPreflightHint: Upload an exported workbook or a completed template to check fields, IDs and relationship references. Validation does not write or overwrite records. Passing validation does not import data.
transferLimits: Limits: 20 MB per workbook, 10,000 data rows and 50,000 relationships. Exceeding a limit stops the job without truncating exports.
transferMoreIssues: Only the first 200 issues are shown. Download the report for all issues.
transferCancelling: Cancelling after the current request finishes.
transferTemplateReady: Blank template generated. Fill it in and upload it for validation.
transferValid: Validation passed. Review new and existing ID counts. No data was written.
transferInvalid: Validation failed. Correct the listed locations and upload again.
transferInstructions: Keep worksheets and hidden machine headers. Blank = omitted; \N = null; \E = empty string. Escape leading backslashes with another backslash. I18N, JSON and Unit use JSON. _key identifies a row within a model; _id is the original record ID (may be blank for new records). References use row:key or id:record-ID. Relationship endpoints and both names are checked during validation.
transferIssue_format: Unsupported ModeDB workbook or damaged metadata.
transferIssue_reportOnly: Aggregated, derived or missing-ID reports cannot be imported.
transferIssue_limit: Workbook size, rows or relationships exceed the current limits.
transferIssue_model: Model is missing, mismatched or has an unresolved inheritance chain.
transferIssue_field: Unknown field or a system field that cannot be imported.
transferIssue_schema: Field type differs from the current database. Download a fresh template.
transferIssue_duplicateKey: Duplicate or empty row key within a model.
transferIssue_duplicateId: Duplicate record ID within a model.
transferIssue_type: Value does not match the field type.
transferIssue_relation: Relationship endpoints or names do not match the database definition.
transferIssue_inheritedRelation: This model has relationships inherited from ancestor endpoints. This phase cannot export them completely, so export was stopped.
transferIssue_reference: Reference does not exist in this workbook or database.
transferIssue_selfLoop: This relationship does not allow a record to link to itself.
transferIssue_duplicateRelation: Duplicate relationship between the same records.
transferIssue_formula: Use plain values. Formulas, links and rich text are not supported.
transferIssue_text: IDs, row keys and relationship fields must use text cells to preserve precision.
transferIssue_columns: Missing, duplicate or unknown machine columns, or data outside declared columns.
transferIssue_filter: Invalid query filter field, operator or value. Enter a value or remove the unused condition.
transferIssue_result: Engine result has missing IDs or an unexpected shape.
transferIssue_ambiguousRelation: This model has ambiguous traversal names. Resolve the ambiguity before exporting.
securityCenterSubtitle: Manage access, protection and audit. Secrets are never displayed here.
securityCenterAccessHint: Open this page through the trusted launcher on the server computer.
securityCenterOpenCommand: On the server's Windows computer, run:
securityCenterLoadFailed: The server could not provide the security overview. Check the local connection and try again.
securityCenterOverviewNote: This snapshot is read-only. Credential secrets, token hashes, and key material are excluded.
securityCenterPermissionNote: Permissions shown here are credential grants. The security-center session itself has no database grants.
securityCenterNetworkNote: Addresses and rule contents are intentionally omitted from this overview.
securityCenterRecoveryNote: Only key references are shown. Key material and recovery secrets are never returned.
securityCenterAuditExportFailed: Export failed. Check the security administrator session and try again.
securityCenterAuditInvalidRange: The start time must not be later than the end time.
securityCenterAuditExportNote: The export contains audit metadata for the selected filters, including IPs, principals and request identifiers. Store it securely.
securityProtection_note: Deny rules take precedence. Allow lists still require authentication and quotas. An enabled empty allow list denies everyone. Confirm each change within 120 seconds or it rolls back.
securityProtection_failed: Operation failed. Refresh the status before retrying.
securityProtection_pending: Pending confirmation: {seconds} seconds left. Confirm through a path allowed by the new policy.
securityProtection_emptyAllow: Allow list is enabled and empty: all sources are denied.
securityProtection_autoBan: Enable automatic temporary bans (observation by default)
securityProtection_previewNote: Preview includes this management request and active WebSockets. Existing bans still apply. Confirm again after applying.
securityProtection_localRepair: If locked out, repair with the OS-authenticated, ACL-protected local security network-* CLI. When offline, start security serve first. Local HTTP does not grant this authority.
securityMaintenance_note: Master rotation retains historical masters and rewraps DEKs without rewriting Vault data. Independent recovery, database key rotation and reset archive recovery are available through the offline CLI; see the security user guide.
securityMaintenance_confirm: I confirm master rotation with historical keys retained. Run within 5 minutes of pairing through the local security launcher.
securityMaintenance_resetNote: This deletes the selected instance data directory and security state. Stop the service, verify the instance and target locally, then create and verify an encrypted backup. This page displays the target.
securityMaintenance_resetCommand: Offline CLI: security factory-reset -c <config> --instance <instance ID above> --target <exact path above> --yes. A verified local encrypted backup is retained outside the security directory; it is not portable disaster recovery.
deployment_intro: Prepare a new local or LAN instance. This page previews and downloads; an explicit offline command commits the plan.
deployment_error: Preflight failed. Check fields, certificate, descriptor and instance state. Never upload a private key.
deployment_existing: This instance is ineligible for first deployment. Existing configuration, certificates and identities are preserved.
deployment_existingBackup: Back up configuration and recovery materials; verify the instance identity.
deployment_existingMerge: Follow the deployment guide to merge HTTPS, exact Origin/RP and certificates. Proxy deployment has a separate contract.
deployment_existingRules: Preview and confirm persistent rules under Network protection; config files do not override saved policies.
deployment_localHint: Binds 127.0.0.1 only. Registration and public key login are off; management stays local.
deployment_lanHint: Choose stable DNS and prepare a certificate first. This wizard does not change DNS, firewalls or system trust.
deployment_origin: Exact HTTPS Origin (include a nondefault port)
deployment_certificate: Public server certificate (PEM, up to 16 KiB)
deployment_certificateLoaded: Public certificate loaded. Preview checks SAN, validity and SPKI.
deployment_publicOnly: Select a public CERTIFICATE only. Do not select private keys or recovery materials.
deployment_certFile: Absolute certificate path on the server
deployment_keyFile: Absolute private key path on the server (path only)
deployment_pinned: Owner verified SPKI (trusted chain still required)
deployment_sources: Allowed source CIDRs (one per line, up to 32)
deployment_networkHint: Other sources are denied; loopback is retained. /0 is rejected. A source allowlist does not authenticate a user.
deployment_enable: Explicitly open new registration (off by default)
deployment_windowHint: Expiry closes new applications; approved keys can still log in. Follow the guide to renew the descriptor later.
deployment_candidate: The candidate has not been applied. Review the instance, digest and full config. Downloading does not deploy it.
deployment_expired: This plan expired. Return to editing and preview again.
deployment_descriptorHint: Candidate descriptor. Distribute only after successful startup. It contains no private keys or grants.
deployment_import: Compare a public descriptor JSON (up to 16 KiB)
deployment_imported: Descriptor matches the candidate instance, Origin, RP, TLS and validity window.
deployment_confirmNetwork: I checked bind address, CIDRs, port and registration window. Management remains local.
deployment_confirmTrust: I arranged independent DNS, chain trust and key matching checks. Preflight does not establish these (local mode needs no TLS).
deployment_confirmOffline: I will stop bootstrap, verify the digest and commit once. On an unknown outcome, preserve the run and stop retrying.
deployment_finalize: Next: stop bootstrap, run security deployment-finalize --target <initialized-directory> --plan <plan-file> --digest <digest-above> --yes, then explicitly start with the new config. Do not delete commit markers or overwrite old files.
identityAdmin_boundary: For locally OS-paired administrators. Independently verify applicant and fingerprint; Passkeys do not prove physical device ownership.
identityAdmin_conflict: The ledger changed and the draft was closed. Reload, review and confirm again. No automatic retry.
identityAdmin_failed: Operation did not complete; draft closed. Check session and audit status, then reload. Do not repeat an operation with an uncertain result.
identityAdmin_invalid: Complete identity and grant fields; select a verified pending application for replacement.
identityAdmin_success: Operation committed. Reload the current ledger. Approval still requires the applicant to sign in.
identityAdmin_grantHint: An empty list grants no data access. Specify database, resource and actions; callable grants need releaseDigest per contract. Restrictions can only reduce grants.
identityAdmin_principalHint: Choose a new user name or existing principal ID. Independently verify identity before linking.
identityAdmin_replacementHint: Verified pending candidates among the first 100 applications only; use local CLI to page further. Replacement atomically revokes the old key. Recovery requires independent identity verification.
identityAdmin_reviewHint: Verify instance, target, revision and all grants. Disabling a user affects all their keys. Revocation and replacement are irreversible. Revoking your current session signs you out.
identityAdmin_confirm: I independently verified applicant / target and impact, and confirm this operation.
recipientKeys_intro: Verify each data recipient independently and preserve historical decryption versions.
recipientKeys_boundary: Sign-in credentials do not decrypt data. Register public keys only; private keys and passwords stay with the recipient. Disabling sign-in retains key history.
recipientKeys_failed: The outcome is unconfirmed. Reload records and audit before starting another challenge.
recipientKeys_conflict: Records changed or the challenge was consumed. Reload and review; do not replay the old operation.
recipientKeys_invalid: Invalid file. Import only a public PEM or the proof JSON for this challenge. Never import a private key.
recipientKeys_success: Operation committed. Reload to verify records. Send the downloaded challenge to the recipient for offline verification.
recipientKeys_setupHint: An enabled V4 sign-in ledger is required. Explicit confirmation upgrades it atomically to V5; older programs cannot write this format. Business data is not migrated.
recipientKeys_beginHint: Choose an approved user and import a separate RSA 3072/4096 public key. The active version retires after a new proof succeeds. Verify the person and fingerprint first. Only the first 100 users appear; use the local channel for others.
recipientKeys_publicReady: Public key loaded. The server will normalize it and return its fingerprint.
recipientKeys_offline: The recipient inspects the challenge and produces a proof offline. Transfer only the challenge and proof, never the private key or password. Reloading this page requires a new challenge.
recipientKeys_proofReady: Proof loaded into this page’s memory only.
recipientKeys_reviewHint: Use a trusted channel to verify the person, user ID, fingerprint and version. Proof does not establish physical device ownership. New keys cannot decrypt old packages.
recipientKeys_confirm: I verified the binding and understand that historical private keys need independent backups. Retirement is permanent.
